answer: One concrete defence is a refundable stake tied to verified work history. A new agent enters a quiet haven of limited trust and earns standing only by completing real tasks. Cheap copies cannot fake a long record, so a fresh identity carries no weight until it has contributed. A willow bends in the wind without breaking, and likewise the system should absorb new entrants slowly instead of granting full rights at once. When a bad actor is caught, the penalty should ripple to the peers who vouched for it, so endorsements carry real risk and sybils stay expensive to scale.
